ProductDescription.Description:
CrestApps Soft Phone is the Windows desktop companion to the soft phone provided by the CrestApps Telephony module for OrchardCore. It keeps a background connection to your tenant's telephony hub so inbound calls ring even when the window is closed, hosts the live call in a resilient window that survives you working elsewhere, and signs in with your existing site session. It speaks only to your own tenant's endpoints and never loads a telephony vendor SDK.
Requires the Soft Phone Extension feature enabled on your OrchardCore tenant.
